The '''Laser Guidance Module '''is an Attack Mod that boosts ranged attacks.
==​Description==
''Improves the speed, accuracy, and damage of your Base Defender's projectile attacks using advanced laser-guidance technology.''

== Max Stats ==
1-Star
* Health: 219
* Attack: 19
* Max Rating: 38
2-Star
* Health: 456
* Attack: 40
* Max Rating: 85 (sig 10)
3-Star
* Health: 1,449
* Attack: 126
* Max Rating: 282 (sig 40)
4-Star
* Health: 5,965
* Attack: 519
* Max Rating: 1,116 (sig 20)

==​Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* Projectile Damage
* Projectile Speed

=== Abilities ===
*''Ranged Attacks:''
**Additional damage equal to 17.5%~28% of the defender's Attack Rating.
**+20~35% Critical Rate.
**+40~65% projectile flight speed.

== Strategy ==
It is best to pair this module with Bots that rely on Ranged basic, heavy, and special attacks with special abilities. 
* [[Ironhide]] 's missiles can become more deadly.
* [[Starscream]] can more effectively nullify opponents' buffs.
* [[Waspinator]]'s projectiles fly faster when at half health. Combine this with this mod and the Predacon can swiftly sting attackers.
* [[Hound]]'s basic ranged attacks deal even more damage with his ballerina skills unlocked.
* [[Blaster]] will enjoy seeing his enemies' ranged attacks slow to a halt while his ranged attacks zoom faster.
* [[Hot Rod]] relies on Ranged Attacks for his basic Deceleration to work, this Mod increases that chance.
* [[Galvatron]]'s Ranged Attacks are already deadly, when he's on this Mod his Ranged Attacks will be even more deadlier.
* [[Megatron]]'s full powered Ion Cannon shots will fly faster.
* [[Megatron (ROTF)]] will make his tank blasts and Special 2 all the more terrifying.
* [[Arcee]]'s debilitating Headshots will be more potent.
* [[Thundercracker]] will turn Heavy Attack into a nightmare, especially if he had Damaging Debuffs that were Purified.

=== Raiding ===

* [[Blaster]] can slow down ranged speed.
